subject.title: Feature Request: Token Efficiency & Agent UX Improvements (Agent Perspective)

question: Should this broad umbrella stay open as a coordination tracker until the bootstrap/context and outbound metadata slices resolve, or should maintainers split the remaining work into narrower canonical issues and then close the umbrella?
rationale: The remaining gaps are real, but the issue spans public config semantics, prompt/session behavior, outbound privacy, cron policy, plugin discovery, usage reporting, and update UX, so automation should not choose the permanent product and security boundary.

options.title: Keep umbrella until split
options.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers explicitly assign the bootstrap/context and metadata-delivery slices to canonical trackers or PRs.

options.title: Split then close
options.body: Create or bless narrower canonical issues for each remaining slice, preserve the production evidence here by linking it, then close this umbrella as superseded.

options.title: Close after implementations land
options.body: Wait until the open bootstrap/context trackers and outbound metadata PR or replacement are resolved, then close this issue as implemented or superseded.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella until split
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers explicitly assign the bootstrap/context and metadata-delivery slices to canonical trackers or PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across bootstrap, heartbeat, subagent output, and prior maintainer-side reviews of this issue family.
